description: This file contains the PHP class 'Notification' which manages notification data within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving notifications, each interacting with the database. The class is part of the Opencart.Admin.Model.Tool namespace and extends the engine Model class.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A model class for handling notifications in the Opencart admin system, providing CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Inserts a new notification record into the database with provided data and returns the new record's ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific notification identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes a notification from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific notification by its ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications, optionally filtered by status, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total number of notifications, optionally filtered by status.
